what_this_shows: The first real Level 1 option order to actually fill, end to end, against the real Alpaca paper API: preview -> approval -> a human typing EXECUTE PAPER -> broker fill -> reconcile -> ledger. This was the one remaining unproven step in the whole project -- submission, OCC symbology, and the confirmation gate were already proven live (queue 7, CVX, cancelled unfilled); a fill was not. It is now.
shariah_trace: AAPL: underlying=PASS (SEC_EDGAR). structure=cash_secured_put -> PASS (100% cash-collateralized purchase commitment (Arboun/Wa'd); no margin financing). account=CASH -> PASS (no standing riba exposure).

portfolio_sync.reason: option fills are audited but not tracked in the equity position ledger -- CLAUDE.md known limitation #2, unchanged by this trade

real_bug_found_and_fixed_along_the_way.summary: validate_sell_reduction in paper_execution.py required a local equity position for *any* SELL, with no asset_class exemption -- the same equity-only-rule-applied-to-options bug shape already fixed twice elsewhere in this codebase (agent_coordinator's side/quant filters), just never hit here because the one prior live option order (CVX, queue 7) happened to sit on top of an existing 1-share CVX equity position and passed by coincidence.

queue_9.reason: no local AAPL position is available for account 0TCX
queue_9.note: This queue_id exposed the bug: a genuine cash_secured_put sell-to-open on AAPL, an underlying with zero local equity position, was incorrectly rejected at execution time despite clearing every real gate (Shariah, option-structure, account, risk) at approval.

real_bug_found_and_fixed_along_the_way.fix: validate_sell_reduction now reads asset_class from the staged preview payload and returns PASS immediately for asset_class == 'option', matching the reasoning already established for the other two option-aware exemptions: ownership/collateral for Level 1 structures is proven by option_structure_gate and account_shariah_gate at approval time, not by this equity-only ledger check. TDD: a test reproducing the zero-position option SELL was added to test_paper_execution_gates.py (placed before the existing seed_position() call specifically so it can't pass by the same coincidence that hid the bug in production), confirmed red before the fix, green after. Full 40-suite regression clean, ruff clean.

queue_10.reason: stale limit price -- 1.05 was the bid at submission, but AAPL260828P00305000's bid moved to 1.00 within under two minutes, leaving the limit resting above the bid rather than marketable. Cancelled cleanly (filled_qty 0, no partial) and reconciled before retrying with a fresh quote. This is the exact same failure class 4a73e6b already documented for queue 7 (CVX), just on a much faster timescale -- worth noting for anyone re-running this: re-quote and submit as close together as possible.
